vulnerability.name: USN-6560-3
vulnerability.description: USN-6560-2 fixed a vulnerability in OpenSSH. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.   Original advisory details:   It was discovered that OpenSSH incorrectly handled user names or host  names with shell metacharacters. An attacker could possibly use this  issue to perform OS command injection.

statements.status_notes: OpenSSH could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it received a specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
